gaps.explanation: The statement (p5, printed p18) is on the modified accrual basis. The Street, Sales Tax and Debt Service schedules in detail[] are 'Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis' (pp13-15, printed pp56-58). Fund by fund: General 795,872 = General Fund departments pp17-18. Debt Service 11 = 11. Other Funds 264,606 = nonmajor combining p16 (3,200 + 10 + 633 + 33,212 + 187,448 + 40,103). Street Fund: statement 271,107 (interest income 17,727) vs cash-basis Total resources 266,846 (p13, interest income 13,466) = -4,261. Sales Tax Fund: statement 208,188 (interest income 4,335) vs cash-basis Total resources 206,484 (p14, interest income 2,631) = -1,704. 4,261 + 1,704 = 5,965, the full gap. The difference is accrued vs cash-received interest, not a missing line.

General 717,764 and Other Funds 314,271 (19,568 + 347 + 179,627 + 114,729, p16) agree. Street Fund: statement 124,163 (p5: public works 120,701 + principal 3,462) vs cash-basis Total charges to appropriations 127,437 (p13: 123,975 + 3,462) = +3,274. Debt Service Fund: statement 142,974 (p5: 1,114 + 135,000 + interest 6,860) vs cash-basis 143,134 (p15: 1,114 + 135,000 + interest 7,020) = +160. 3,274 + 160 = 3,434, the full amount by which the schedule is above the statement (gap -3,434). These are budgetary cash-basis vs modified-accrual differences.
